Name: Krobus to Ralsei Re-sprite
Author: Entropes
Description:
A re-sprite of Krobus to Ralsei Deltarune
Only changes are to the portrait and character of Krobus
Every sprite of Krobus is changed (If I missed any please do tell)
The sprites are made by me, but the portraits are ripped from Deltarune with some modifications
I tried to make the sprites look as much as Deltarune as possible
If you want me to make it look more like other Stardew characters, give me a shout!

This is my first ever mod published here, feedback would be appreciated

[b]Inspired by this mod:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9809]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9809[/url]

[b]To install:[/b]
Simply drag the content file to the Stardew Valley directory

Though backup your Characters and Portraits folder if you want to revert the re-sprite since it's semi-permanent
